Noah (CS): Reminder: Orion reserved pool ignition rehearsal tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need final quota, autoscale policy, and test owner. Who can lead the run?
Sam (Ops): Ops can coordinate provisioning. Requested target = 3500 rps peak, sustained target 2200 rps. Propose reserve 6xA100 for 3h.
Diego SRE: propose a soft-roll warmup: 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 90m to let KV and prefix caches stabilize. Also recommend sample priming with long-tail prompts.
Priya Eng: I can own the load harness. Prefer Artillery + prometheus exporter. Will store scenarios in repo and tag pre-run.
Nadia (Orion): confirm quota looks good. note: our internal cron job runs at 10:15 PT, avoid overlapping heavy traffic then.
Sam (Ops): ack cron window. updated warmup windows: 09:30, 10:45, 12:00 PT. Autoscale policy idea: scale_up_delta=2 replicas, cool_down=60s, scale_down_delta=1, target_gpu_util=70%. Open to tweaks.
Noah (CS): Need billing flag: reserve_id Q-ORION-0826, please loop in finance for approval. @finance FYI.
OncallBot: reserve allocation requested: pool_id=rp-9001, nodes=6xA100, window=3h, owner=Orion. Allocation pending.
Diego SRE: priming checklist: 1) run 15m prefix replay at low conc, 2) run mixed-profile traffic to fill hot KV to ~25%, 3) abort if p95 > 400ms or errors > 0.8% for 10m.
Priya Eng: load snippet (example):
```
artillery run --target https://api.redwood.prod -s artillery/orion-scenario.yml -d 45m
```
Priya Eng: will capture metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, token throughput, GPU temp, mem headroom, queue lengths. Alert if GPU util > 93% for 3m.
Nadia (Orion): sending traffic mix and 8k sample prompts to Noah now. Also sharing expected prompt length histogram.
Sam (Ops): runbook draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orion-ignition. includes fallback plan to hosted-fallback and steps to scale down safely.
Diego SRE: note on fallbacks: if we hit OOMs or token regressions, fallback policy = switch to model-variant stable-v2 and re-run warmup at half traffic.
Noah (CS): Risk note: if we miss our SLOs this week, renewal conversation could get pulled forward. Schedule post-mortem same day at 16:30 PT with customer and eng.
Sam (Ops): final readiness ping will go 45m before start. react with :white_check_mark: when checklist items are complete.
Nadia (Orion): thanks everyone — looking forward. will be on the call for the first two windows.
Priya Eng: will push scenarios to git.redwood/internal/loads/orion-ignition branch=orion-ignition-2026. I'll post link once pushed.
Noah (CS): perfect. closing loop: paste results to this thread and attach perf snapshot to the account folder. :tada:
